arguments.details: Section 1 caps client entertainment at $100 per person; Sales Hospitality Standard 1.0 section 1 allows $150 per person for the same events; no precedence rule is configured.

arguments.message: Client Entertainment Guidelines 1.0 section 1 caps client entertainment at $100 per person, while Sales Hospitality Standard 1.0 section 1 allows $150 per person, and no precedence rule is configured between them. The Knowledge Desk has flagged this conflict to the owner of the Client Entertainment Guidelines for clarification.
